title: EngineCapabilityState
description: Schema for append-only capability events and merged current state.

event_id.description: Monotonic event ID assigned by the store.

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the observation.

endpoint.description: Exact endpoint wallet identity. Absence means legacy endpoint-ambiguous evidence.

endpoint_binding.description: Output-only identity provenance for merged current/report views.

runner_version.description: Version of the runner if known.

observed_at.description: Output-only observation time of the quota event selected by the merged current view.

event_id.description: Output-only event ID of the quota observation selected by the merged current view.

source_role.description: Output-only role provenance for a role-agnostic quota merge.

native_observed_at.description: Output-only (merged `current`): observed_at of the event that set `native`. Consumers gating on native freshness MUST use this, not the aggregate observed_at.

prompt_pack_observed_at.description: Output-only (merged `current`): observed_at of the event that set `prompt_pack`.

context_window.description: Observed context window for this runner+model. Consumed by scripts/check-context-budget.js to size a dispatch before it spends anything. Windows DRIFT — the same model id has been observed with two different windows — so a recorded observation outranks the estimator's built-in default table.

total_tokens.description: Total context window in tokens, as reported by the engine at runtime (codex: event_msg.token_count.info.model_context_window; grok: signals.json .contextWindowTokens). null = unknown, which never clobbers a valid observation.

observed_at.description: Output-only (merged `current`): observed_at of the event that set `total_tokens`.
